scope: aggregate coverage only; no model fitting or test scoring

facts.sql: SELECT count(*) AS sales_lines,count(distinct order_id) AS orders,count(distinct store_id) AS stores,count(distinct sku_id) AS skus,count(distinct day) AS observed_dates,min(day) AS first_date,max(day) AS last_date,sum(quantity) AS units,sum(net_paise) AS net_paise,min(quantity) AS min_line_quantity,max(quantity) AS max_line_quantity FROM sales_transactions

store_coverage.sql: SELECT min(n) AS min_days,max(n) AS max_days,count(*) AS series FROM (SELECT store_id,count(distinct day) n FROM sales_transactions GROUP BY store_id)

store_category_coverage.sql: SELECT min(n) AS min_days,max(n) AS max_days,count(*) AS series FROM (SELECT store_id,category,count(distinct day) n FROM sales_transactions GROUP BY store_id,category)

store_sku_coverage.sql: SELECT min(n) AS min_days,max(n) AS max_days,count(*) AS series FROM (SELECT store_id,sku_id,count(distinct day) n FROM sales_transactions GROUP BY store_id,sku_id)

daily_distribution.sql: SELECT min(units) AS minimum,max(units) AS maximum,avg(units) AS mean FROM (SELECT day,sum(quantity) units FROM sales_transactions GROUP BY day)

zero_or_negative_lines.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM sales_transactions WHERE quantity<=0

competitors.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows FROM competitor_sales
